findings.title: Native StaticMaterial constructor does not expose imported_material_slot_name
findings.issue: FStaticMaterial.ImportedMaterialSlotName is VisibleAnywhere-only. The installed native-struct wrapper adds constructor InitParams only from script-exposed TypeGetSets, which require BlueprintVisible/BlueprintAssignable. Editor-only properties are included in PythonProperties for get_editor_property but are not TypeGetSets constructor parameters. The current StaticMaterial keyword call is unsupported, so the approved append path cannot execute with this installed API. Its TypeError is fail-closed, but blocks every fresh trial at the chimney. No native invocation was performed in this review.
findings.why_tests_miss: The recording Slot constructor explicitly accepts imported_material_slot_name; all680 Python checks can pass without matching the installed native constructor exposure. The existing unsupported-constructor negative proves safe refusal, not successful native construction.
findings.primary_evidence: primary_source_pins.json; PyWrapperTypeRegistry.cpp2239–2265,2344–2361; PyGenUtil.cpp1609–1613; StaticMesh.h514–515. Python-defined-struct InitParams code around PyWrapperStruct.cpp1537 is a different path.
findings.reproduction: constructor_signature_reproduction.json shows an installed-exposure-constrained recording constructor rejects the keyword with zero mesh setters. It is not presented as native execution.
findings.requested_change: Use a concretely supported metadata initialization operation after reviewing its installed API, or revise the delivery policy to retain legitimate used-only native slots with exact source-used-role correspondence while keeping full declared/used/unused source inventory.
